title: MC 1304: Piping Support
officialText:
1304.1 General.

Pipe supports shall be in accordance with Section 305. Piping serving equipment at levels above the lowest floor or storage tanks at levels above the lowest floor in buildings shall also comply with the requirements of Section 1305.9.6 and 1305.9.7.
